attributes.action: Introduce Autism Support Levels in the UK
attributes.additional_details: Autism is a spectrum, but in the UK everyone receives the same diagnosis regardless of support needs. In the USA, autism support levels (1, 2 and 3) help show how much support a person needs. I believe the UK should introduce a similar system so that on paper, someone who is non-speaking, has pica, a learning disability and needs constant supervision isn’t viewed the same as someone with much lower support needs. This would help support, education and funding better reflect individual needs.
attributes.background: Introduce autism support levels in the UK so that, on paper, people’s different support needs are recognised instead of everyone receiving the same diagnosis.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on recognising different levels of support required  by people with autism, which you may wish to sign:

Require NHS autism diagnoses to include assessment of level of support needed
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770800
